build_ast_from_source: build an AST from C++ source code using BuilderFromSource with source string and filename
generate_ast_nodes: generate AST nodes from an AstBuilder instance by calling Generate on a token stream
print_identifiers: print all identifiers from a C++ source file using PrintIndentifiers with a filter predicate
convert_cpp_types: convert C++ token sequences to Type objects using TypeConverter.ToType method
parse_cpp_methods: parse C++ method declarations and definitions using AstBuilder._GetMethod
